purpose: Teach: 加筆/手直し/終点/公示/客室/税別/免税/効能

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文に加筆を加えて完成させろ
lines.en: Ren, add to that paper and get it finished.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Not unkind but economical with words. A task stated as fact, not a request. Light weight on the period.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置の手直しを技術員に依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask the technician to adjust the experimental equipment.
lines.style: Quick, respectful nod in the voice. Alert and ready. No hesitation — he's already mentally moving to the next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究計画の終点設定を見直せ
lines.en: Ren, review the endpoint markers in your research plan.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Brief pause after the name — giving weight to what comes next. Firm but not sharp. Expects competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究募集の公示文を準備中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing the recruitment notice for the study posting right now.
lines.style: Calm, attentive confirmation. The 'right now' carries quiet assurance — he's already on it. No over-promise, just steady action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会客室の予約を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, confirm the conference accommodation bookings.
lines.style: Direct task assignment. Slight stress on the verb — make sure this is done. Professional rhythm, no inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究予算は税別表記で記録します
lines.en: Yes. I'm recording the research budget with tax-exclusive notation.
lines.style: Precise and responsible. Each phrase lands cleanly. He's anticipating what accurate record-keeping looks like before being told.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者の海外免税申請を支援しろ
lines.en: Ren, handle the overseas tax exemption paperwork for the researchers.
lines.style: Substantial task but delivered matter-of-factly. Ren is trusted with this. The verb sits heavy — this matters. No hedging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料の効能を学会で発表いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll present the sample efficacy data at the conference.
lines.style: Respectful closure. The commitment is firm and clear. Slight formality on the verb form — he's elevating the moment. Ends with quiet confidence.
